name: R080-spark-whiscash-future-sight-milotic
why: Challenge 4. The player's Milotic (559, Marvel Scale) fights the opponent's Whiscash (483: Surf, Earthquake, Spark, Future Sight). When Spark paralyses Milotic (30 percent) and the AI later uses Future Sight on the statused Milotic, the stored damage is computed with Marvel Scale's Defense bonus (calculateFutureAttackBaseDamage). Milotic keeps attacking with Ice Beam; the AI picks among its four moves each turn.
